[[File:Moss giant icon.png|left]]
'''Moss giants''' are a species of giant that live in [[Gielinor]] and are tied with [[ice giant]]s for third strongest giant. They attack with [[melee]] and are weak to fire spells, however melee is also effective against them. Moss giants are popular for training on [[Free-to-play]] worlds, because they are one of the few creatures that drop [[Big bones]].

Free-to-play players can find moss giants in the [[Varrock sewers]], whilst members can find 20 in [[Brimhaven dungeon]]. 875 coins or completion of the hard [[Karamja achievements]] is required to enter the dungeon. As Brimhaven dungeon can be dangerous for lower-levelled players, an alternative location is the [[Moss giant island]] west of [[Brimhaven]]. Level 10 [[Agility]] is required to access it.

They are sometimes given out as [[Slayer]] assignments by [[Mazchna]] and [[Vannaka]].

*** Spirit Weed seeds - [[Automaton (monster)|Automatons]], [[Strykewyrm]]s, [[Turoth]]s, [[gemstone dragon|Gemstone Dragons]] (on task), [[brutisch dinosaur|Brutish Dinosaurs]], [[Grotworm]]s, Moss Giants, [[flesh crawler|Flesh Crawlers]], [[Cockatrice]]s, [[Kurask]] and [[seed drop table|Rare Seed Drop Table]].

* {{UL|type=patch|update=November PostJam Patch Week - This Week In RuneScape|date=25 November 2024}}
** Replaced the [[medium plated steel salvage]] drop with [[maple wood spirit]]s.
** Replaced the [[medium spiky mithril salvage]] drop with [[acadia wood spirit]]s.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Housing of Parliament & Double XP- This Week In RuneScape|date=12 February 2024}}
** Rebalanced several low level monsters that were harder to kill than intended

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=This Week In RuneScape: Yak To Basics and Ninja Strike 20!|date=1 March 2021}}
** Moss giants now attack with melee and are weak to fire spells. Some moss giants' levels and stats were also changed.

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=Patch Notes (17 August 2015)|date=17 August 2015}}
** Various gauntlets are now dropped from additional NPCs:
*** Mithril - moss giants

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (18 March 2013)|date=18 March 2013}}
** [[Grotworm]]s, moss giants, [[banshee]]s, [[jungle spider]]s, [[shadow spider]]s, [[spider]]s, [[giant spider]]s, [[deadly red spider]]s, [[ice spider]]s, [[scorpion]]s, [[poison scorpion]]s and [[pit scorpion]] will no longer hit for 1 hit point worth of damage.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (9 June 2009)|date=9 June 2009}}
** Fixed the examine on the bones of moss giants.

*{{UL|type=update|update=New section of sewer opened|date=5 February 2001}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* As referred to Armies of Gielinor, Moss Giants are followers of [[Guthix]].
* As seen in the 6th [[Postbag from the Hedge]], a moss giant's beard has a life of its own. The only known beard currently is [[Dave the Beard]].
* As shown during the [[2017 Easter event]] through Guthix's memories in the [[divine egg (ent)]], Moss Giants came from the same world as the [[Giant ent]] species.
* Moss Giants originally attacked with melee, but their attack style was changed to ranged with the release of the Evolution of Combat. It has since been changed back to melee as of March 2021.
